  "non_facet_columns": [],

  "exhaustiveness": 0.85,
  "rationale": "All five columns are genuine part-of aspects of a company_business_profile rather than external predictors or causes, satisfying the meronymy requirement. Mutual exclusivity is good but not perfect: business_model, service_delivery_mode, and industry_focus overlap substantially (e.g. 'software_platform' business model correlates heavily with 'cloud_saas' delivery and 'software_development' industry; value categories like 'security_compliance' echo the 'cybersecurity' industry). This shared underlying dimension of 'what kind of software/product company it is' reduces non-overlap. Exhaustiveness is strong for the query's stated scope (business models + customers): it covers model, customer, delivery, industry, and value proposition. Minor gaps include revenue/monetization mechanics and company scale/stage, which are also constitutive aspects of a full business profile but are not decomposed here."
}
